snippet.title: My First Playing in Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Fortress (PS Vita) Closed Beta
snippet.description:
Here's my gameplay video of the very first stage of a new Gundam free-to-play game on PS Vita.
The full game is available now at Japan PlayStation Store. You need to use a Japan PSN account with a PS Vita to access and play the game.
https://store.playstation.com/#!/ja-jp/%E3%82%B2%E3%83%BC%E3%83%A0/%E6%A9%9F%E5%8B%95%E6%88%A6%E5%A3%AB%E3%82%AC%E3%83%B3%E3%83%80%E3%83%A0-%E3%83%90%E3%83%88%E3%83%AB%E3%83%95%E3%82%A9%E3%83%BC%E3%83%88%E3%83%AC%E3%82%B9/cid=JP0700-PCSG00579_00-BATTLEFORTRESS00?EMCID=jGMpsnTOP_a0002

Short brief review (lol): 
The game is simple; pretty much like Clash of Clans Gundam style. Create HQs, buildings, and units to destroy other fortresses. =w="

Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A86fqgUrwY4

(c) Bandai Namco Games Japan
